The **Plasma Gun** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*.

Similar to pipe weapons, the player can only craft a pistol type weapon. Changing the grip to stock will change the name and weapon type to a plasma rifle. Enemies killed with the plasma gun can sometimes be liquefied into green plasma goo, which allows the recovery of Nuclear Waste from the puddle.
